citations.title: Handling Component Shortages
citations.quoted_text: When a required component is short, notify the shift supervisor before adjusting the build schedule.

steps.original_text: When a required component is short, notify the shift supervisor before adjusting the build schedule.
steps.explanation: Tell your shift supervisor about the shortage before you change anything on the build schedule.
